thread:
Nina (PM): Drafting a compact, tenant-aware canary pattern for the next model push. Key goals: per-tenant holdbacks, tiny micro-canaries, automated SLO-based fallbacks, and a clear enterprise manual gate. Posting the short plan + questions.

Diego (SRE): Sounds good. Ops rules: start at 0.1% global or 1% in a single low-risk region. Always enable shadowed traffic capture for 12-24h. Circuit-break defaults: p95 > baseline_p95 + 35% for 10m OR error_rate increase > 0.8pp for 5m -> fallback.

Sofia (Eng): Implementation: add model labels compat=[full,quant,lite] and fallback order quant->lite->previous. Flag naming: rollout/model/<name>/v<semver>/<scope> where scope=global|region|tenant. Separate holdback key: rollout/model/<name>/holdback/<tenant-id>.

Evan (Sales): Customers expect 14-day notice and a per-tenant opt-out link. Enterprise SKUs default to manual approve unless buyer opts into auto-updates. Need an email template.

Nina (PM): Rollout phases (compact): Phase 0: internal shadow + synthetic checks. Phase 1: micro-canary 0.1% global OR 1 region @0.5% for 2x20m windows. Phase 2: regional ramp 2%->10%->40% (30m windows). Phase 3: global after 24h stable. Q: approve thresholds?

Diego (SRE): Approve with one change: add cost guard. If token_cost > baseline_token_cost + 25% -> throttle to baseline RPS and page. Also prevent >2 rollbacks in 1h to avoid oscillation.

Sofia (Eng): Telemetry contract: required metrics: request_count, p50/p95/p99, error_rate, token_cost, sampled_semantic_eval. Semantic eval: 200 golden prompts every 10m; flag if median delta > 0.03 for review.

Evan (Sales): Agree. Also require per-tenant audit log entry when holdback toggled.

canary-bot: Scheduled: rollout/model-hawk/v3 -> region=eu-west-1, initial=0.1%, windows=20m x2, shadow=true. Watch p95, error_rate, token_cost.

Nina (PM): Action items: Sofia/Diego finalize exact numeric thresholds and routing precedence by EOD; Evan to draft opt-out email. If no blockers, we'll attach this to the release checklist. Thanks.
